items.title: Khalifa: The Ruler
items.overview: Aamir Ali, a notorious gold smuggling kingpin who inherited his multi-million dollar criminal enterprise from a lineage of gangsters, is drawn into a web of vengeance, legacy and power.

items.title: Bethlehem Kudumba Unit
items.overview: Ashley's homecoming from abroad takes an emotional turn when a wedding next door stirs memories of her first love, Justin.

items.title: Pradhama Drishtiya Kuttakkar
items.overview: Follows a woman constable who joins the police force through appointment after the death of her husband.

items.title: Drishyam 3
items.overview: To protect his family and their dark secret, Georgekutty faces an organized new threat. As walls close in and cracks widen, how much more is he willing to sacrifice?

items.title: Super Sharanya
items.overview: Sharanya, an ordinary small-town girl from Palakkad, who moves to Thrissur for higher studies, finds herself changing as she meets Deepu.

items.title: I'm Game
items.overview: A fearless gambler who trusts luck more than life gets caught in a series of crazy and unexpected events that turn his world upside down.

items.title: Dridam
items.overview: A police officer arrives at a seemingly peaceful station but faces pressure when human remains are discovered. Given only a week to solve the murder, he must navigate demands from his department and an anxious public seeking swift justice.

items.title: All We Imagine as Light
items.overview: In Mumbai, Nurse Prabha's routine is troubled when she receives an unexpected gift from her estranged husband. Her younger roommate, Anu, tries in vain to find a spot in the city to be intimate with her boyfriend. A trip to a beach town allows them to find a space for their desires to manifest.

items.title: Mollywood Times
items.overview: Vineeth Madhavan tries hard to become Malayalam cinema's greatest horror filmmaker, but will the toxic industry affect his dream?

items.title: Daveed
items.overview: A celebrity bodyguard finds himself in trouble when he crosses an infamous boxer.

items.title: Jenny
items.overview: Jenny, a young software professional from a coastal village in Kerala, returns home to spend a few days with her family before leaving for work. When a renovation forces her estranged grandfather back into her life, long-buried memories begin to resurface.

items.title: Unmadham
items.overview: Haunted by his past, a police constable reopens an unsolved cold case. As hidden secrets surface, he must confront truths that challenge his beliefs forever.

items.title: Sambhavam Adhyayam Onnu
items.overview: Three Kerala Police officers venture into a mysterious forest on the Kerala-Tamil Nadu border to find a missing officer. They encounter strange time-related phenomena, uncovering the hidden secrets of Velloorkkatt forest.

items.title: Marco
items.overview: The adoptive son of the Adattu family, Marco, sets off on a ruthless quest for vengeance after his brother is brutally murdered, finding only betrayal, loss and unimaginable brutality at every step.

items.title: Bramayugam
items.overview: A folk singer in 17th-century Kerala discovers a mansion. Inside, he encounters an enigmatic cook and a powerful master, setting in motion a chain of events that changes his life.

items.title: Premalu
items.overview: Sachin, a carefree graduate, crosses paths with Reenu, a spirited IT professional, in Hyderabad. As their friendship deepens, unspoken feelings, career ambitions and life choices challenge their bond.

items.title: I, Nobody
items.overview: Rajeevan, an ordinary government employee, witnesses something he was never meant to see and is thrust into the centre of a serious crime. Branded a troublemaker and hunted by the system, he must protect his family while fighting to survive against forces far beyond his control.

items.title: Pallichattambi
items.overview: Set in the politically turbulent late 1950s, Krishnan Pillai, a playful ruffian chosen by the Church to lead a defensive force, the Christopher Sena. items.title: Kattalan
items.overview: Power-hungry forces clash in the Ivory cartel war-a fierce story of control, vengeance, and survival where compassion vanishes and only the ruthless endure.

items.title: The Goat Life
items.overview: Indian migrant worker Najeeb Muhammad goes to Saudi Arabia to earn money. However, in a twist of fate, he finds himself living a slave-like existence, herding goats in the middle of the desert.

items.title: Sarvam Maya
items.overview: An atheist priest's life is upended after performing an exorcism, bonding with a charming spirit who helps him pursue music and heal his past.

items.title: Balan - The Boy
items.overview: A teenage boy searches for his missing mother following a turbulent childhood and her subsequent disappearance, exploring his search for closure and the truth about his past.

items.title: Khalifa 2 : The Legacy
items.overview: A prequel to Khalifa: The Ruler that narrates the story of Mambarakkal Ahmed Ali and the events which led to him becoming a smuggler and crime-lord.

items.title: Patriot
items.overview: When a Malayali DRW analyst tries to expose a corrupt regional politician from Kerala and his malpractices regarding spyware, he goes on the run, becomes a vlogger, and must clear his name of the false allegations levelled against him.

items.title: Anomie
items.overview: Zaara, a relentless sister seeking answers in her brother's unresolved case, confronts a police officer after days of failed investigation. As faith in the system erodes, she pursues the truth on parallel paths, leading to a haunting revelation.

items.title: Vaazha II
items.overview: Four friends – Hashir, Alan, Ajin and Vinayak – are considered losers and troublemakers by parents, family and the school management. items.overview: The family's journey to Sreekandapuram to settle the late Bharathan Nair's second wife and son takes a dark turn when an issue from his past resurfaces, leading to an unexpected crime.
